newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAfrica T-bill seen under 16 pct as offer kept low.
newsitem.headline: SAfrica T-bill seen under 16 pct as offer kept low.

text.p: The average rate on three-month Treasury bills at Friday's weekly sale should fall back comfortably below 16 percent from 16.09 last week as the amount of paper on offer remains low, money market traders said.

South Africa's Reserve Bank said it was again offering only 600 million rand of 91-day bills at the auction -- the same as last week, but 300 million down from the usual 900 million rand that is on offer.
Traders said the lower offering would increase competition, putting downward pressure on the yield.
The offering of six-month bills was increased to 200 mlillion rand from 100 million last week.
The Reserve Bank will announce the results of the tender at 1000 GMT.
